column9: In my opinion, giving immediate feedback is not particularly good since the user immediatly feels either down (gave wrong answer) or excited (gave correct answer). It is very likely that a user will give a wrong answer at least once, therefore, she/he will feel down for the next question(s). I would give the correctness and feedback (with detailed explanation) at the end of all the questions. Like this, the user does not get frustrated during the answering of the questions.
